records.reason: Official self-description of the enacted IRA; redundant with later implementation and outcome evidence kept below.
Administration advocacy text on the IRA; repetitive official framing without added outcome value.
Declarative EO language about IRA implementation; largely promissory and overlapping with stronger implementation records.
Direct target-period poverty outcome with a Census attribution to expanded Child Tax Credit policy.
Direct 2022 poverty statistic with safety-net decomposition, useful for target-year household hardship.
Broad life-expectancy trend has weak Biden-specific attribution and is less decision-linked than the retained health outcomes.
Direct 2022 maternal-mortality outcome with a clear racial disparity, one of the strongest health measures in-period.
Useful pandemic-era school-meal context, but too close to the kept child-nutrition implementation evidence to justify another official record.
Concrete 2022 child-nutrition funding and implementation action tied directly to access and service support.
Specific WIC formula-flexibility response during the 2022 shortage; direct crisis-management evidence.
Independent policy research showing Marketplace sign-ups rose with ARPA subsidies and outreach.
Primary-source account of IRA health-cost effects and timing, central to affordability policy.
Direct late-2022 affordability metric for Marketplace coverage, useful independent of self-described official claims.
2023 coverage-cycle rulemaking is later and less direct than the retained target-year coverage evidence.
Direct guidance on children's coverage and behavioral-health access with clear service implications.
Concrete crisis-care policy design for Medicaid mobile crisis services, tied to access expansion.
Independent analysis of Medicaid enrollment growth and continuous coverage preventing churn.
Large 2022 homelessness and voucher allocation with explicit housing-and-supportive-services purpose.
Scales housing vouchers and emergency rental support; direct housing-stability evidence.
Target-year veteran-homelessness decline with a clear quantified change.
Forward-looking homelessness plan; prospective intent rather than realized 2022 outcome evidence.
Contemporaneous AP report on DPA use and emergency flights during the formula shortage.
Confirms the formula-shortage response, but largely repeats the same crisis-management mechanism from another wire family.
Useful housing-affordability context, but not direct Biden-specific causal evidence.
Independent Brookings analysis that tests whether student-debt relief targeted the intended borrowers.
Model-based pre-2022 distributional context explaining why debt relief mattered for equity.
Structural education-access context on pandemic learning loss; not a direct 2022 policy outcome.
Direct national mental-health strategy implementation with workforce and access levers.
Rural maternity access program with concrete grant design and intended outcome support.
Out-of-period 2023 care-experience evidence; broader system-quality context rather than a 2022 Biden action.
Direct duplicate of the retained KFF Medicaid enrollment item.

remaining_concerns: The retained set still leans on official implementation records for health, housing, and nutrition, though independent corroboration now anchors the main mechanisms.
Several dropped items are useful background but were omitted to keep the official-primary share below the ceiling and to avoid repeating the same policy mechanisms.
